record.context_brief: Critically finite maps on projective space
record.original_question: Let f: P^n -> P^n be a critically finite rational map in the sense that there exist hypersurfaces V subset W subset P^n such that f maps P^n - W to P^n - V as a covering map. Are there nontrivial examples for which P^n - V is Kobayashi hyperbolic, and if so how do such maps behave dynamically?

evidence.quote: More precisely, say f is critical finite if there exist (possibly reducible) hypersurfaces V ⊂ W ⊂ P n such that f : (P n − W ) → (P n − V ) is a covering map.
Problem. Are there nontrivial examples of critically finite maps with P n − V Kobayashi hyperbolic? How do they behave dynamically?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A rational self-map $f:\mathbb{P}^n\to\mathbb{P}^n$ (with $n\ge 2$) is called critically finite if there exist (possibly reducible) hypersurfaces $V\subset W\subset\mathbb{P}^n$ such that the restriction $f:\mathbb{P}^n\setminus W\to\mathbb{P}^n\setminus V$ is a covering map. A complex space $X$ is said to be Kobayashi hyperbolic if its Kobayashi pseudodistance is a genuine distance (equivalently, every holomorphic map $\mathbb{C}\to X$ is constant).

Construct nontrivial examples of critically finite maps $f:\mathbb{P}^n\to\mathbb{P}^n$ for which the complement $\mathbb{P}^n\setminus V$ is Kobayashi hyperbolic, and describe the dynamical behavior of such maps (e.g., structure of their Fatou and Julia sets, behavior of critical orbits, ergodic properties).
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work has produced nontrivial examples of critically (post-critically) finite endomorphisms of $\mathbb{P}^n$ whose post-critical complement is Kobayashi hyperbolic, and has analyzed their dynamics: for instance, it is known that when $\mathbb{P}^k\setminus P(f)$ is Kobayashi hyperbolic, the only Fatou components are basins of superattracting cycles. However, a full classification and dynamical description in arbitrary dimension is not complete, so the question is partially addressed rather than fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: Dynamics of post-critically finite maps in higher dimension
status_evidence.snippet: Studies PCF endomorphisms of P^k and Kobayashi hyperbolicity of complements of post-critical sets.
status_evidence.claim: PCF maps with Kobayashi-hyperbolic post-critical complement have been constructed and studied dynamically.

status_evidence.title: Critical orbits of holomorphic maps on projective spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Generalizes critically finite map theory to higher-dimensional projective spaces.
status_evidence.claim: There exist results extending critically finite dynamics from the Riemann sphere to P^n.
